notes.title: 4/7/23 v0.10.14
notes.content:
Patch notes:
1. The FATAL ERROR that occurs when killing an enemy has finally been resolved!
You can now play normal A to Z play. Thank you for trusting and waiting.
2. Fixed an intermittent game freeze when killing enemies with Assualt's Double Shot skill.
3. Fixed an issue where enemies hit by Assualt's Rush skill would respawn.
4. The costumes of Enemy Recruit, Enemy Rifleman, and Enemy Sniper have been changed.
You can now easily differentiate between Enemy Sniper and Enemy Assualt.

Developer comments:
The v0.10.15 update schedule is as follows.
1. We plan to modify the spread and assemble of allied squads to be more natural.
2. We plan to fix the phenomenon that allied Police do not sit down immediately after spreading.
3. We plan to fix the abnormal assembling state when an ally character dies.
4. Please note that this update may be lengthy due to excessive efforts to solve FATAL ERROR and crashes.

notes.title: 4/5/23 v0.10.13 - hotfix13
notes.content:
Patch notes:
1. Fixed an issue where some skills could not be selected with the mouse.
2. Fixed a problem where Sniper's Accuracy Rate was negative or out of maximum.
3. Adjusted lighting and fog to better differentiate character classes.

Developer comments:
1. We are working hard to fix game crashes.
We will prevent this from happening in the v0.10.14 build.
2. We plan to fix major bugs after resolving game crashes.
We will also change the Sniper's outfit to better differentiate it from the Assault.
3. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the lack of service.
We will definitely repay the trust you gave us.

notes.title: 4/2/23 - v0.10.13 - Hotfix3
notes.content:
Patch notes:
1. An issue where animations were not applied to police soldiers is fixed.
This also solves the problem of not being able to progress through the game.
2. An issue where the battle event probability was set too high is fixed.
3. An issue where allied and enemy policemen use rifleman sounds is fixed.

Developer comments:
We apologize for any inconvenience to those who have experienced this game for the first time.
If the game cannot progress, we will fix it as soon as we find the cause.
Thank you to the person who reported the game progress through the evaluation.

notes.title: Squad game is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
1. Squad game is now in Early Access!

2. Several minor updates have been applied since the beta version.
  1) Adjust all combat and skill stats of allies and enemies
  2) Fixed a bug where the game would end if the turn went over with the enemy surviving alone being stunned
  3) Fixed a bug where allied assaults did not spread with a 25% chance
  4) Modified the notation so that the critical hit rate of damage analysis is close to the actual critical hit rate

3. The less important update history is as follows.
  1) Fixed an issue where friendly squads move forward whenever an event occurs
  2) Fixed an issue where only the skill cooldown icon remained in the ally info ui when the ally turn ended
  3) Fixed a bug where certain skills were activated when restarting after moving to the main menu during game play
  4) Fixed a bug that could create multiple pause windows

4. Our plans for future updates are as follows.
  1) First of all, I would like to receive intensive feedback from users for about two weeks.
  2) After that, minor updates will be conducted on an irregular basis about 2 to 4 times a month.
  3) When an appropriate level of minor updates are accumulated, a major update is performed.
  4) When an appropriate level of major updates are accumulated, the game is officially released.

5. It's a game that lacks a lot, but we hope it will be fun for someone.
